findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The sheet dealt General Sans and General Sans, but the page renders Geist, Geist Mono.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Named for the first bug" (screen 12, 84% over a picture); "15:45" (screen 12, 73% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
